title: Engine Fire In Flight
cues: Fire light ON in associated FIRE PULL handle
steps: If fire persists: Fire Extinguisher ENG — POSITION 2
Affected Engine — SHUT DOWN (see Engine Failure In Flight, E-10)
Aircraft — LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE

title: Engine Fire On Ground
cues: Fire light ON in associated FIRE PULL handle

title: APU Fire
steps: If fire persists: Engine 2 FIRE PULL — PULLED; shut down ENG 2

title: Engine Failure During Takeoff — Before V1
cues: Yawing (ENG 1 or 3) or ENG 2 FAIL light

title: Engine Failure During Takeoff — After V1
cues: Yawing (ENG 1 or 3) or ENG 2 FAIL light
steps: Landing Gear Handle — UP when positive rate of climb
At 400 ft AGL min: V2+15 SLATS ONLY; V2+25 CLEAN WING

title: All Engines Out
steps: If no relight: Prepare Forced Landing/Ditching

title: Smoke Removal / A/C Smoke
cues: Smoke at A/C outlets or in cockpit/cabin
steps: Smoke Goggles — DONNED, vent valve open
Bleed Air ISOLATION — ISOLATION; CREW OFF; PRV OFF

title: High Cabin Altitude / Slow Depressurization
steps: Bleed Air CREW, CABIN, PRV — ON or AUTO
Cabin Pressure Selector — MAN as required
Emergency Descent if needed (to 14,000 ft / safe alt)

title: Three Generators Inop
steps: Each Generator — NO MORE THAN 2 RESETS EACH
Reduce battery load: BOOST/XFR/WINDSHIELD/ANTI-ICE/Interior/Exterior lights — OFF as appropriate
Aircraft — LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE

title: Inadvertent Flight Thrust Reversal
steps: If stows: Continue; switch REMAINS STOWED
If remains deployed: LAND ASAP (One Engine Inop)
